task: Classify transient, validation, authentication and rate-limit failures. Bound attempts and use provider retry guidance.
acceptance: Transient failure can recover; invalid data stops; exhausted retries alert.
challenge: Replay a failed send without duplicating side effects.

controls.approval: bind to exact draft when action requires review
controls.idempotency: persistent stable-key handling required for real side effects
controls.logs: no secrets or unnecessary personal data
